Method of Attack: Critical authentication bypass allowing unauthenticated access to restricted REST API endpoints
Manipulation of chat sessions including injecting and editing messages
Denial of Service (DoS) by arbitrarily ending active chat sessions
Persistent cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability allowing injection of malicious JavaScript
Malicious redirection, pop-ups, and fake subscriptions via injected JavaScript
Impacted Systems: WordPress websites using WP Live Chat Support plugin
Attack Vector: Exploitation of REST API endpoints via authentication bypass
Injection of malicious JavaScript via XSS vulnerability
Indicators of Compromise: Injected malicious JavaScript content causing redirection, pop-ups, and fake subscriptions
